caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man shown from the shoulders up, facing slightly to his left. The man's skin is a light tan with shading to show the contours of his face. He has blue eyes, brown eyebrows, reddish-brown sideburns, and a moustache. His hair appears wavy and brown, extending out from under his hat. He is wearing a black beret-style hat with a red-and-white checkered band, and his jacket or garment is black, featuring a silver button at the neck and a section of red tartan or plaid draped across his right shoulder. The drawing is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Wooden Scotchman
